text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock a 60m design review for the next API + SDK + Console connector changes. Goal: walk through schema v2, SDK auth flow, and console UX for connector onboarding so we can start the RFC rollout next sprint.

maria: Pre-read is here: https://redwood.internal/docs/dr/342 — pls skim before the meeting. I added a TL;DR at the top.

maria: Proposed slots (PT): Tue 4/13 10:00-11:00, Wed 4/14 14:00-15:00, Thu 4/15 09:00-10:00. React with :one: :two: :three: or reply with conflicts.

jamie: :one: works for me but I might need to drop 20m early. Can we record?

arjun: Wed (2pm) is best for run-time perf folks. Thu morning is rough for infra.

santosh: I can do Tue or Wed. Prefer Wed for bandwidth.

priya: Wed 14:00 PT if possible — I want to demo the console flow.

maria: Recorded + notes. Who can take notes? I can chair. Need a primary reviewer for API schema (jamie?), runtime perf owner (arjun), console owner (priya), security (julian).

julian: I can be there for a security pass. Wed 14:00 PT preferred.

maria: OK Wed 4/14 14:00 PT is shaping up as the winner. Final ask: upload any slide snippets, example payloads, and a short list of acceptance/regression checks by EOD Mon 4/12.

maria: Quick checklist — paste into doc or attach:
```
- design doc (link)
- example request/response (proto/json)
- perf impact summary (p50/p95 token/sec)
- rollout & rollback criteria
- any data residency notes
```

jamie: I'll drop the API surface diff and request/response JSONs by Monday.

arjun: I'll add perf microbench and 95th stats. Might include a short flame graph screenshot.

priya: I'll attach Console mockups + click walkthrough and a short script for the demo.

santosh: Heads up — I have a conflicting all-hands Wed 14:00-14:30. If we keep Wed, I might join late.

maria: Noted. We'll try to keep first 20m for context then deep dive. If you miss first 20m, santosh, you'll be fine.

jamie: small question — do we want to land schema changes behind a feature flag or rollout to a shadow endpoint first? Put as agenda item.

maria: Yes — agenda item: feature-flag vs shadow rollout vs canary. Also: SDK auth backwards-compat.

priya: Also add a quick UX decision checkpoint: minimize clicks vs explicit permission flow.

julian: Security: scope review + token rotation implications. I'll prepare a 3-bullet slide.

maria: Thanks. If anyone else should be invited, @mention them here. Planning to send calendar invite once we confirm Wed 4/14 14:00 PT.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Design Review — API/SDK/Console (DR-342)" — Wed Apr 14 14:00-15:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/events/aj3k

maria: Invite sent. Please RSVP in calendar and upload pre-read artifacts by EOD Mon. I'll post a final agenda on Tue morning. :thumbsup:
